histoire.title: Our Story
histoire.p1: Jonathan Patoine didn't follow a single path. He walked many — tree planter, security guard, police officer, restaurant entrepreneur, editor for Montreal media — and in each one he searched for the same thing without always being able to name it: a place where his skills meet something truly worth doing.
histoire.p2: He found that something for the first time on an Atari screen. Not in the game itself, but in what it represented: living proof that a little code could create an entire world. That fascination never left him.
histoire.p3: In December 2022, his business closes by government decision. He starts over with his brother, opens a franchise, fights hard. It's not enough. Then a CISO — head of cybersecurity for a regional health authority — opens an unexpected door. Jonathan enrols in an AEC program at Collège Cumberland. He learns protocols, networks, vulnerabilities. By learning how systems fall, he finally understands how they work.
histoire.p4: It's during this period that he begins working with artificial intelligence — not as a tool, but as a partner. He realizes something fundamental: he's no longer blocked behind the wall of knowledge he'd need to acquire before creating. Imagination can precede mastery. He begins building his game studio. He begins dreaming bigger.
histoire.p5: In early 2026, his editorial contract in Montréal ends. That's the supernova. The explosion that precedes the rebirth.
histoire.p6: In March 2026, the group is officially founded — with a precise mission: start local. Help entrepreneurs and artisans in the region build their digital presence and truly live from what they love doing. Like the log drivers who married physical rigour with mastery of the rivers, Boreal Star Group marries the rigour of our historical builders with the power of tomorrow's technologies. The first pilot project: a Brazilian jiu-jitsu dojo in Québec City. A passionate instructor struggling to reach enough clients. Exactly the kind of person this was built for — no matter where they're from. Our roots are regional, but our doors are open to anyone who asks. In May 2026, the group adopts its definitive name: Boreal Star Group Inc.
histoire.quote: Polaris guided the coureurs des bois through the darkest nights. Today, it guides regional entrepreneurs through the digital flow. We are that star.

divisionWeb.hero_description: Just as the log drivers mastered the wild rivers of Québec, the Draveur Division masters the digital flow of your business. We build robust web portals that optimize your web traffic and work for you — even while you sleep. Fast, beautiful, SEO-optimized and maintained by a local team that understands what entrepreneurs here actually need.

services.desc: Robust web portal design, custom, mobile-first, ultra-fast loading. Your online image at the level of your work — optimized to convert visitors into clients.
Sell your products 24/7. Inventory management, Stripe payments, your own dashboard.
Online appointment scheduling, time slot management, automatic reminders.
Organic web traffic optimization for your region. Show up first when your customers search for what you offer — and maintain that position in Google results.
Logo, color palette, typography — a consistent brand that stands out.
Updates, security, content — we keep your site healthy while you focus on your business.

divisionCyber.hero_description: Your data, your infrastructure, and your clients' trust deserve serious protection. We analyze, secure, and train — so you can grow without hidden vulnerabilities.

services.desc: Complete analysis of your systems to identify vulnerabilities before someone else does.
Strengthening your networks, servers, and workstations following industry best practices.
Quebec Law 25 compliance, privacy policies, access management, and encryption.
Your employees are your first line of defense. We train them on real threats: phishing, passwords, risky behaviors.
Response plan in case of compromise — minimize damage, regain control fast.
The threat landscape evolves. We stay current so you don't have to worry about it.

divisionCyber.approche_texte: Cybersecurity isn't just for large corporations. A compromised SMB means stolen client data, a damaged reputation, and significant recovery costs. We make protection accessible, understandable, and proportional to your reality.
